{{Otheruses|Operations Chief}}
The '''Navy Operations Chief''' was the de jure head of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] [[Navy Operations]] branch. [[Zi Sturgist]] held this position, although he was an underling of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]].
